concerns.text: Verification for T006 only checks that the model file loads and resource usage is within limits; it does **not** assert that the baseline null‑model R² (`null_model_r2`) is recorded. This leaves SC‑001 (test‑set R² measured against the baseline null model) uncovered, effectively weakening the success criterion.

The verification for T006 does not confirm that Leave‑One‑Family‑Out cross‑validation is actually performed nor that the grid‑search is limited to ≤ 10 hyperparameter combinations. Without these checks, FR‑003 (LOFO CV and ≤ 10 combos) is weakened.
